record.question: The initial public offering of ARAMCO, the most profitable company in the world has been agreed by
record.explanation: Answer B: Saudi Arabia. Saudi Aramco was wholly owned by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia when the IPO was proposed in November 2019; the government was the selling shareholder. Reference: https://www.aramco.com/en/news-media/news/2019/announcement-of-intention-to-float-on-tadawul; https://www.aramco.com/-/media/images/investors/saudi-aramco-prospectus-cma-en.pdf?hash=8887077F5ACCE26916E6DA8A953B44771D0C46F1&la=en. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
